latestVersion.changelog:
- Major upgrade: Feedback Loop skill is now self-contained and autodetects integration contexts for richer analysis.
- New architecture: Modular scripts (`observer.py`, `analyzer.py`, `orchestrator.py`) replace previous pipeline, supporting fully standalone operation or enhanced modes with dark-factory and intent-engineering.
- Simplified input system: Accepts any JSON log, plain text, or structured results; dynamically adjusts capabilities based on available files.
- Improved outputs: Generates normalized observations, actionable suggestions, automatic regression tests, alignment checks, and a signed, independently verifiable improvement report.
- Resources reorganized: Added new references and scripts; legacy pipeline scripts and configs removed to streamline workflow.
